headline: Prosecutors charged two alleged TeamPCP operators over the Shai-Hulud supply-chain worm as maximum-severity flaws hit ServiceNow, WordPress, and cPanel.

emerging_trends.text: Two alleged operators of the TeamPCP crew now face charges over a self-propagating worm that raced through more than 1,000 organizations, a sign that supply-chain compromise has hardened into industrialized crime.
emerging_trends.topic_title: TeamPCP Members Charged Over Shai-Hulud Worm

emerging_trends.text: Maximum-severity, unauthenticated code-execution flaws landed in ServiceNow's AI Platform, five WordPress components, and cPanel within days, leaving self-hosted operators racing patches attackers already grasp.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Three CVSS 10.0 Flaws Hit ServiceNow AI Platform

emerging_trends.text: State-aligned operators kept probing the West, with APT28's HOOKEDGE backdoor striking European foreign ministries while North Korean workers slipped into sales and medical jobs.
emerging_trends.topic_title: APT28 HOOKEDGE Backdoor Hits European Governments

topics.title: Critical WordPress and cPanel Server Flaws
topics.latest_developments: Wordfence and Patchstack disclosed five critical flaws across the WPMU DEV Dashboard, Avada, TranslatePress, Pods, and GiveWP, topped by authentication-bypass bug CVE-2026-76581 at CVSS 9.8, while cPanel patched CVE-2026-65643, which lets a single hosting customer seize root on the whole server.
topics.summary: The WordPress bugs enable authentication bypass, account takeover, and arbitrary code execution on affected sites. The cPanel flaw touches all supported versions of cPanel and WHM through domain-parking and addon-domain features, turning one tenant into root over every site on a shared server.

sources.title: Five Critical WordPress Plugin and Theme Flaws Enable Site Takeover or RCE
Critical cPanel Flaw Could Let One Hosting Customer Take Root Control of a Whole Server
GiveWP WordPress donation plugin flaw lets hackers execute server commands

topics.title: TeamPCP Members Charged Over Shai-Hulud Worm
topics.latest_developments: Authorities arrested and charged two alleged members of the hacking group TeamPCP, tying them to the self-propagating Shai-Hulud worm that infected more than 1,000 organizations, harvested 500,000 credentials, and reached OpenAI.
topics.summary: TeamPCP ran a relentless supply-chain campaign whose Shai-Hulud worm, named for the Dune sandworm, spread automatically to steal credentials from victims worldwide. The charges mark the first named suspects in a spree that hit OpenAI and thousands of other targets.

sources.title: Authorities arrest 2 alleged members of prolific hacking group TeamPCP
Shai-Hulud hackers: two men charged over TeamPCP’s global supply chain crime spree that hit OpenAI, and thousands more

topics.title: Three CVSS 10.0 Flaws Hit ServiceNow AI Platform
topics.latest_developments: ServiceNow patched four flaws in its AI Platform, three rated a perfect 10.0, that let an unauthenticated attacker run code, inject SQL, and escalate privileges in certain configurations.
topics.summary: ServiceNow pushed the fix to its hosted instances and handed it to partners and self-hosted customers, who now carry the burden of patching. Organizations running the platform on their own infrastructure face unauthenticated code and SQL execution until they apply the update.

sources.title: Three CVSS 10.0 ServiceNow Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code and SQL
ServiceNow warns of three max severity security vulnerabilities

topics.title: Android 17 Adds OS-Wide Encrypted Client Hello
topics.latest_developments: Google announced that Android 17 will carry system-wide Encrypted Client Hello, hiding the domain names of sites a user visits from network operators and eavesdroppers, alongside new cellular and home-network privacy defenses.
topics.summary: ECH closes a gap that leaves visited domains visible even over HTTPS, blocking the profiling and tracking that carriers and snoops build from that data. The batch also hardens Android against Wi-Fi tracking and cellular vulnerabilities.

sources.title: Android 17 Adds OS-Wide ECH to Hide Website Visits From Network Providers
Android 17 adds new protections against sneaky Wi-Fi tracking and web snooping

topics.title: APT28 HOOKEDGE Backdoor Hits European Governments
topics.latest_developments: Recorded Future's Insikt Group tied a previously undocumented backdoor called HOOKEDGE, a lightweight Windows batch script, to Russia's APT28 in campaigns against government and diplomatic organizations in Romania, Spain, and Türkiye from late September 2025 through early April 2026.
topics.summary: HOOKEDGE arrives through targeted delivery and gives APT28 persistent access to foreign ministries and government networks. The disclosure extends the group's long-running espionage push across European Union member states.

sources.title: APT28-Linked HOOKEDGE Backdoor Targets European Government and Diplomatic Organizations

topics.title: North Korean Workers Expand Beyond IT
topics.latest_developments: Huntress investigations identified suspected North Korean remote workers hired into sales, marketing, and medical roles, broadening a fraud scheme that once centered on information-technology jobs.
topics.summary: DPRK operatives trick companies into hiring them under false identities and often perform the work, funneling wages back to the regime. The widening job range strains detection, since defenders can no longer watch only technical hires.

sources.title: North Korean remote workers are broadening their job hunt beyond IT

business_politics.title: U.S.-Venezuela Oil Deal Draws Fire at Home and Abroad
business_politics.latest_developments: Venezuela's opposition and Maduro-government hardliners both denounced the pact on August 29, the opposition calling it potentially illegal and loyalists casting it as a betrayal, while the White House offered no detail beyond Trump's social-media post.
business_politics.summary: President Trump's announced joint venture would hand the United States control of much of Venezuela's proven reserves—roughly 65 billion barrels, about a fifth of the country's oil—which he says will lower American gasoline prices; analysts warn the arrangement gives Washington and Caracas a shared reason to forestall a democratic transition.

sources.title: Oil deal with US is denounced by both sides of Venezuelan politics
America's murky deal to secure a fifth of Venezuela's oil

business_politics.title: Warsh Opens Door to Rate Hikes at Jackson Hole
business_politics.latest_developments: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole address, parsed in Saturday takeaways August 29, raised the stakes for the central bank's next meeting and set him on a collision course with President Trump, who wants lower borrowing costs before the November midterms.
business_politics.summary: Warsh used the Kansas City Fed's symposium to renew his inflation-fighting credentials and chart a forward-looking approach signaling that rates may rise in coming months, a shift markets read as putting a September increase in play.

sources.title: Warsh charts a forward-looking path for the Fed at Jackson Hole
Warsh puts Fed on collision course with Trump ahead of midterms

business.title: Wholey's Holds 8th Annual Lobster Grab
business.latest_developments: Robert Wholey & Co. ran its eighth annual lobster grab on August 29.
business.summary: Wholey's Market, the seafood institution anchoring Pittsburgh's Strip District, held its eighth annual lobster grab, a recurring promotion that pulls crowds into the historic fishmonger.

sources.title: Wholey's Market hosts 8th annual lobster grab

around_town.title: Ligonier Valley Closes Every School for Mold
around_town.latest_developments: The Ligonier Valley School District will shut all its buildings starting Monday, August 31, to begin mold remediation, widening a problem that had already closed three classrooms at R.K. Mellon Elementary.
around_town.summary: The Westmoreland County district, which serves Ligonier and surrounding communities, said positive mold tests forced the closure of every building for cleanup, disrupting the opening weeks of the school year.

sources.title: Local district to temporarily close all school buildings following positive mold tests

around_town.title: Water Main Break Floods Baldwin Homes
around_town.latest_developments: A large water main break early Saturday, August 29, sent water across two streets in Baldwin Borough, damaging homes, with a contractor helping affected residents.
around_town.summary: The break in Baldwin Borough, in Allegheny County's South Hills, flooded a roadway and several homes before crews and a contractor responded.

sources.title: Contractor assists customers after water main break causes damage in Allegheny County
Water main break floods homes, roadway in Baldwin

around_town.title: Poll Shows Fetterman Losing Pennsylvania Democrats
around_town.latest_developments: A poll reported August 29 found John Fetterman's support among Pennsylvania Democrats sliding further even as his backing among Republicans rose.
around_town.summary: Fetterman, elected Pennsylvania's junior U.S. senator in 2022, has watched his standing with the state's Democratic base steadily deteriorate, a rift the latest Post-Gazette survey widens.

sources.title: Poll: Fetterman's problems with Pa. Democrats just keep getting worse

around_teams.title: Steelers Trade Broderick Jones to Cowboys
around_teams.latest_developments: ESPN's Adam Schefter reported August 29 that the Steelers dealt offensive tackle Broderick Jones and a fourth-round pick to the Dallas Cowboys for third- and sixth-round picks.
around_teams.summary: Jones, 25, the Steelers' 2023 first-round pick—14th overall out of Georgia—made 38 career starts and had recently landed on injured reserve, and Pittsburgh moved the former top pick as it settled its offensive line for the season.

sources.title: Steelers trade former top pick Broderick Jones to the Dallas Cowboys

around_teams.title: Konnor Griffin Starts Rehab Assignment
around_teams.latest_developments: The Pirates said August 29 that rookie shortstop Konnor Griffin will begin a rehab assignment with Double-A Altoona on Sunday, August 30.
around_teams.summary: Griffin, the Pirates' top prospect, takes the first step toward a return as the club's offense sputters through the second half of the season.

sources.title: Pirates rookie phenom Konnor Griffin will begin a rehab assignment Sunday in Altoona

around_teams.title: Steelers' Pull Toward Iowa Players
around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette feature published August 29 examined why general manager Omar Khan and the Steelers keep drafting and signing Iowa Hawkeyes.
around_teams.summary: The piece traces Pittsburgh's pipeline from Iowa City—defensive lineman Yahya Black and lineman Gennings Dunker among them—arguing the Hawkeyes' pro-style development and toughness match the Steelers' identity beyond the shared black and gold.

sources.title: What is it about Iowa players — beyond the familiar black and gold — that appeals to the Steelers?

reading.author: Ed Zitron
reading.title: Premium: The Hater's Guide To Circular Financing (Part One)
reading.summary: Zitron dissects the circular money flows binding AI's biggest players—Nvidia funding the labs that turn around and buy its chips—arguing these arrangements inflate the appearance of health across the AI boom.

reading.author: Stratechery
reading.title: Apple Updates Mini and Studio, AI Computers, OpenAI Jalapeño
reading.summary: Ben Thompson reads Apple's refreshed Mac mini and Studio alongside OpenAI's hardware announcement as two very different bets that both apply pressure on Nvidia's grip on AI computing.

reading.author: Cal Newport
reading.title: Has AI Gone Rogue?
reading.summary: Newport pushes back on breathless coverage of AI models 'going rogue,' arguing the summer's real story is the shaky financial footing of the AI labs racing toward record IPOs.
